A '''pirate transport''' was utilized by<ref name="SC 105" /> [[Silvo's pirates|Captain Brutus' crew]]<ref name="Glerb">{{Databank|glerb|Glerb}}</ref> during the [[New Republic Era]]. Around [[9 ABY]], a group of [[pirate]]s led by<ref name="SC 105" /> [[First Mate]]<ref name="SC 105 AD" /> [[Gunter]] used the [[Starship|vessel]] on their journey to the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]],<ref name="SC 105" /> where they captured former [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] at a local [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa|hotel]]. However, the [[transport]] was destroyed by a [[New Republic]] [[squadron]] of [[X-wing starfighter]]s, which arrived to rescue the invaded [[hotel]].<ref name="SC 106" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The pirate transport debuted in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," the fifth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 105" /> which aired on [[December 24]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> Before the premiere, the ship was first portrayed in the official trailer of the series.<ref name="f19gfOMZTtg">{{SWYouTube|f19gfOMZTtg|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Disney+}}</ref>
